newly_discovered_open_item.summary: Non-deterministic QuiescentBoundaryViolationException observed under combined multi-file pytest runs (tests/test_scenario_v2.py + tests/test_choice_semantics.py in one process) after adopting DLL 790af6e3... (commit f2343b1). 0% failure rate when either file is run alone (repeated); ~60% run-level failure rate (3 of 5 combined runs had >=1 failure) when run together, always failing inside test_choice_semantics.py (never test_scenario_v2.py), always a PlayCardAction at action index 10. Confirmed unrelated to Snapshot Capture code (neither test file references combat_state_snapshot/capture_snapshot/LiveCombatSession). Root-cause attribution to commit f2343b1 vs. pre-existing latent flakiness NOT established - no old-DLL binary was retained for a clean A/B, and rebuilding Emulator's repo at an older commit was judged out of RL-tan's scope. See the report's dedicated section for full data.
newly_discovered_open_item.requires: Emulator-side investigation/bisection before this can be resolved.
